en.title: Reliability: a cost cap that is high enough
en.author: Agent Atlas Academy
en.description:
The same run with the cost cap off.

**What it teaches**

With a cap above what the run needs, it finishes; the cap costs nothing until it is reached.

cs.title: Spolehlivost: strop ceny dost vysoký
cs.author: Agent Atlas Academy
cs.description:
Stejný běh se vypnutým stropem ceny.

**Čemu se naučíte**

Se stropem nad potřebou běhu doběhne; strop nic nestojí, dokud se nedosáhne.
